license_required.quote: no individual shall practice or offer to practice or perform the duties of a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless he possesses a current license issued pursuant to this Part or is exempt from this Part

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Nursing.

name.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Nursing.

type.quote: "Board" means the Louisiana State Board of Nursing.

degree_required.value: minimum of a master's degree with a concentration in the respective advanced practice nursing specialty (for APRN); approved nursing education program for RN
degree_required.quote: the applicant must show evidence of completion of a minimum of a master's degree with a concentration in the respective advanced practice nursing specialty

accrediting_body.quote: Has completed the requirements of a nursing education program approved by the board which prepares him for initial licensure as a registered nurse.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN / Board examination
exams.notes: Board authorizes administration of examination to applicants for licensure as registered nurses
exams.quote: Passes an examination to the satisfaction of the board.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed under the provisions of this Part shall annually renew his license on or before January 31 of each year.

required.quote: The board shall require advanced practice registered nurses practicing family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, obstetrics, or gynecology to complete a minimum of one hour of continuing education on nutrition and metabolic health every four years.

hours_per_period.quote: complete a minimum of one hour of continuing education on nutrition and metabolic health every four years

period_years.quote: complete a minimum of one hour of continuing education on nutrition and metabolic health every four years

topical_requirements.quote: complete a minimum of one hour of continuing education on nutrition and metabolic health every four years

available.quote: The board may by endorsement issue a license to practice as a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse to any applicant who is duly licensed as a registered nurse under the laws of another state, territory, or country

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed an examination for licensure and met qualifications for licensure as a registered nurse in Louisiana at the time of initial licensure, and meet other criteria established by the board.
requirements.quote: Had passed an examination for licensure and met, upon graduation, all other qualifications for licensure as a registered nurse in this state at the time he was initially licensed as a registered nurse.

regulatory_model.quote: no individual shall practice or offer to practice or perform the duties of a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless he possesses a current license issued pursuant to this Part or is exempt from this Part

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license to each applicant who applies for licensure as a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse

is_mandatory.quote: no individual shall practice or offer to practice or perform the duties of a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless he possesses a current license issued pursuant to this Part or is exempt from this Part

title_protection.quote: Use in connection with his name any designation tending to imply that he is a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless duly licensed to practice under the provisions of this Part

scope_protection.quote: Practice nursing unless duly licensed to do so under the provisions of this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, falsely obtaining, or furnishing any nursing diploma or license to practice as a registered nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of selling or attempting to sell, falsely obtaining, or furnishing any nursing diploma or license to practice as a registered nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime or offense reflecting inability to practice nursing with due regard for health and safety, or plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of a crime or offense which reflects the inability of the nurse to practice nursing with due regard for the health and safety of clients or patients or enters a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a criminal charge regardless of final disposition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness or incompetence by reason of negligence, habit, or other cause
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habit, or other cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to use of alcohol or drugs, illness, or mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has demonstrated actual or potential inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to individuals because of use of alcohol or drugs; or has demonstrated inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to individuals because of illness or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting anyone in the violation of any provisions of this Part
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of aiding or abetting anyone in the violation of any provisions of this Part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice nursing or another health care profession denied, revoked, suspended, or otherwise restricted
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice nursing or to practice as another health care provider denied, revoked, suspended, or otherwise restricted.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this Part
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of this Part.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing or registered nursing means the performance, with or without compensation, by an individual licensed by the board as a registered nurse, of functions requiring specialized knowledge and skills derived from the biological, physical, and behavioral sciences.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing" means the performance, with or without compensation, by an individual licensed by the board as a registered nurse, of functions requiring specialized knowledge and skills derived from the biological, physical, and behavioral sciences.

value: Assessing the health status of an individual or group
Establishing a nursing diagnosis and identifying health care needs
Establishing goals to meet identified health care needs

Implementing nursing care through case finding, health instruction, health counseling, providing care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing health care regimens as prescribed
Delegating nursing interventions to qualified nursing personnel
Maintaining nursing care rendered directly or indirectly
Teaching the theory and practice of nursing
Managing and supervising the practice of nursing
Collaborating with licensed physicians, dentists, and other health care providers
methods_authorized.quote: Assessing the health status of an individual or group of individuals. (b) Establishing a nursing diagnosis and identifying health care needs, or both. (c) Establishing goals to meet identified health care needs. (d) Planning nursing care measures. (e) Implementing nursing care through such services as case finding, health instruction, health counseling, providing care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing health care regimens as prescribed by licensed physicians, dentists, or other authorized prescribers.

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice registered nursing may include medical prescriptions of therapeutic or corrective nature, prescribing assessment studies, legend and certain controlled drugs, therapeutic regimens, medical devices and appliances, receiving and distributing a therapeutic regimen of prepackaged drugs prepared and labeled by a licensed pharmacist, and free samples supplied by a drug manufacturer.
drug_authority.quote: Advanced practice registered nursing may include certain acts of medical diagnosis, in accordance with R.S. 37:913(8) and (9), or medical prescriptions of therapeutic or corrective nature, prescribing assessment studies, legend and certain controlled drugs, therapeutic regimens, medical devices and appliances

license_tiers.quote: no individual shall practice or offer to practice or perform the duties of a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse unless he possesses a current license issued pursuant to this Part

aprn_role_categories.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall include, but not be limited to, the following: (a) Certified nurse midwife or "CNM" ... (b) Certified registered nurse anesthetist or "CRNA" ... (c) Clinical nurse specialist or "CNS" ... (d) Nurse practitioner or "NP"

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: under the direction of a licensed physician, optometrist, or dentist acting individually or in his capacity as a member of the medical staff, registered nurse, or physician assistant

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: Except as otherwise provided in R.S. 37:930, acts of medical diagnosis and prescription by an advanced practice registered nurse shall be in accordance with a collaborative practice agreement.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: acts of medical diagnosis and prescription by an advanced practice registered nurse shall be in accordance with a collaborative practice agreement

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: prescribing assessment studies, legend and certain controlled drugs, therapeutic regimens, medical devices and appliances

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Persons who have successfully completed and passed the drug administration course may administer oral medication, ointments, suppositories

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Delegating nursing interventions to qualified nursing personnel in accordance with criteria established by the board.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is hereby recognized and enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single-state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: The registered nurse administers anesthetics and ancillary services under the direction and supervision of a physician or dentist who is licensed to practice under the laws of the state of Louisiana.
